job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services?
job.acceptance: March 20, 2017, 4:30 p.m. HST or explicit equivalent timezone conversion.

reviews.reason: The document is an Oklahoma OPERS RFP issued in 2023 for index investment management services, not the Hawaii ERS 2017 RFP for real estate investment consultant services. Its proposal deadline does not support the requested deadline.
quotes: THE OKLAHOMA PUBLIC EMPLOYEES RETIREMENT SYSTEM REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL #515-24-001 U.S. EQUITY, Non-U.S. EQUITY, AND FIXED INCOME (TIPS) INDEX INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES
OPERS RFP – Investment Management Services – Issued July 20, 2023 Page 1 of 17
The deadline for receipt of proposals is 4:30 p.m. Central Time, on August 11, 2023.
